arguments.command:
cd /workspace/dev && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/dev')
import genbig
lines = []
for seed, style in [(0,'wide'), (1,'wide'), (2,'narrow'), (1,'tight'), (3,'wide'), (2,'tight'), (4,'narrow'), (0,'tight')]:
    x = genbig.gen(seed, style)
    lines.append(json.dumps(x, separators=(',', ':')))
# add error/malformed lines mixed in
lines.insert(2, '{"id": "bad", "version": 2}')
lines.insert(5, 'not json at all')
lines.append('{"id": "last", "version": 1}')
with open('/workspace/dev/multiline.jsonl', 'w') as fh:
    fh.write('\n'.join(lines) + '\n')
print('wrote', len(lines), 'lines')
EOF
/usr/bin/time -v /workspace/submission/run.sh < /workspace/dev/multiline.jsonl > /workspace/dev/multiline.out 2> /workspace/dev/multiline.time; echo "exit=$?"; grep -E "Maximum resident|Elapsed|User time|System time" /workspace/dev/multiline.time; echo "---- output lines:"; wc -l < /workspace/dev/multiline.out; python3 -c "
import json
outs = [json.loads(l) for l in open('/workspace/dev/multiline.out')]
for o in outs:
    print(o.get('id'), o.get('status'), o.get('min_faults'))
"
